title: Technology Sector Update for 01/24/2019: STM, XLNX, LRCX, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.37%
AAPL: +0.43%
IBM: -0.14%
CSCO: +0.48%
GOOG: -0.15%
Most technology stocks were declining pre-market Thursday.
Early movers include:
(+) STMicroelectronics ( STM ), which was up nearly 8% after i t report ed higher sales and earnings early on Thursday, which beat the Street's estimates but warned of a plunge in revenue in the first three months of the year because of "unfavorable dynamics" in some of its end markets.
(+) Xilinx ( XLNX ) was trading over 9% higher as its adjusted EPS rose to $0.92 in Q3 from $0.65 a year earlier, easily topping analysts' estimates of $0.86 in a Capital IQ poll.
(+) Lam Research ( LRCX ) was advancing by more than 6% after reporting Q2 earnings of $3.87 per share, up from $3.36 per share in the prior quarter and ahead of the analyst consensus of $3.68 per share on Capital IQ. Revenue was $2.522 billion, a gain from the $2.330 billion posted in Q3 and better than expectations of $2.495 billion.
